concerns.text: FR-001 and SC-001 require validation of required variables against a specific list. T004a/b reference `data/config/required_variables.yaml` as the source, but no task exists to CREATE or POPULATE this file. Without this artifact, the schema definitions in T004a/b are incomplete and the validation logic in T012 cannot function.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) requires checksums for all data artifacts. T006d is marked as unchecked (missing) and is responsible for defining the `synthetic_data_manifest_schema.yaml` and recording the `code/data_generator.py` checksum. Without T006d, the project cannot satisfy the Data Hygiene requirement for synthetic data generation.

FR-001 and SC-001 require the system to validate variable presence and report the percentage of loaded variables. T012 (write metrics) and T013 (read metrics/halt) are marked as unchecked. This leaves the core 'Dataset-variable fit' validation logic unimplemented, blocking the entire pipeline execution.

FR-001 and Edge Cases require outlier exclusion. T014b (filtering logic and output `filtered_data.parquet`) is marked as unchecked. Without this, downstream tasks (US2/US3) cannot access the cleaned dataset required for analysis, and SC-003 (collinearity) cannot be measured.

FR-002 requires method selection based on data distribution. T021 (method selection) depends on T014b (filtered data) and T020 (distribution checks). Since T014b is unchecked, the input artifact `filtered_data.parquet` is missing, making the execution of US2 (Correlation Analysis) impossible.

FR-006 requires collinearity diagnostics (VIF). T031 depends on T025 (correlation results) and T021f/T021h. Since T025 cannot run due to missing US2 artifacts (blocked by T014b), T031 and the generation of SC-003 evidence are unreachable.

The plan requires a transition to 'Synthetic Only' mode if no real data is found. T053a/b/c/d are marked as checked, but T055 (Real Data Gate) and T056 (Verification) are unchecked. Without T055, the pipeline cannot enforce the 'No-Synthetic-Fallback' rule when `--real-data` is requested, risking silent fabrication or ambiguous failure states.

FR-007 and Assumption-001 require the pipeline to handle large datasets via streaming or fail-fast. T058 (RAM Pre-check), T059 (Streaming Enablement), T059a (Streaming Loader), and T060 (RAM Fail-Fast) are all unchecked. The pipeline lacks the necessary logic to respect the 7GB RAM constraint or handle large datasets as required.

Phase N+4 (Real-Data Execution) requires T064 (Streaming Execution Test) and T066 (Real Data Integration Run) to be implemented. Both are unchecked. Without T064, the streaming logic (T059a) is unverified. Without T066, the pipeline cannot be validated against real data (or the large proxy T070).

Phase N+7 (Review Resolution) requires T073 (Update Constitution Checker) and T074 (Final Report Framing) to be implemented to handle the 'Synthetic Only' state. Both are unchecked. Without T073, the Constitution Checker may incorrectly flag synthetic data as a violation of Principle VI. Without T074, the final report may lack the required 'Study Scope Disclaimer'.

Duplicate Section Header: 'Phase N+7: Review Resolution & Final Validation' appears twice in the document (once before T072a and again at the very end). This is a formatting error that may confuse the execution order or task grouping.
